summary: Ellington Financial Inc. filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, reporting via Item 8.01 the declaration of a routine monthly common dividend of $0.13 per share, payable December 31, 2026 to holders of record as of November 30, 2026; the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 under Item 9.01. No board recommendation beyond the declaration, no advisor, and no transaction mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary capital-return announcement rather than a special situation, so no deal terms apply; monitoring centers on dividend sustainability and monthly payout coverage rather than event arbitrage.
